detail.longDescription: I'm finding that as I get older, I'm becoming more picky in committing to things that require time commitments - even watching a film that I'm not sure about. It's understandable, I'm aware of my limited time. But a major drawback is that it reduces random exploration / serendipitous discovery by trying unknown things out and sometimes being positively surprised. I have always found that kind of intellectual and physical wandering to be hugely valuable in creating alpha. How do you deal this?
